intro: With its sleek design, built-in mirror, and smart organisation, Slimline steel almirah makes life easier—because your storage should work for you, not the other way around.

features.title: Compact, clever, and stylish
features.text: Small space? No problem! This almirah’s smart design is perfect for compact homes, making every inch count while keeping your space stylish and organised.

features.title: Lock away your worries
features.text: Rest easy knowing your essentials are secure. With a reliable door lock, this almirah keeps your valuables safe, giving you peace of mind with every use.

features.title: A shelf for every story
features.text: With multiple adjustable shelves, this almirah adapts to your needs. From clothes to accessories, each shelf keeps your belongings neatly organised and easily accessible.

features.title: Reinforced top for extra space to store
features.text: The reinforced top provides extra space for luggage or other heavy items, making it the ideal companion for those who need smart, additional storage.

features.title: Strength that is built to last
features.text: Built tough, this almirah is constructed with premium CRCA steel, offering durability and strength that stands the test of time, ensuring your belongings are safely stored for years to come.

features.title: Intergrated with stylish mirror
features.text: A sleek mirror adds a touch of elegance, making getting ready a seamless experience. It's the perfect finishing touch to your almirah, combining function with flair.

name: Slimline 2-Door Steel Almirah With Plain Mirror Portabella Matte
